notes:
Context: large media archive (news transcripts, long-form interviews, video captions) spanning ~25M documents / 6B tokens. Customer wants a production-grade RAG search for internal newsroom research + content repurposing. Key constraints: maintain relevance on long documents, control cost per query, predictable latency under load.

Current stance: evaluation stage; legal + infra teams engaged for private deployment. Prefers open/quantized model variants for reranker to control inference cost. Interested in Redwood Dedicated or Private depending on final SLA/legal terms.

Quoted from CTO (Mar 3 call): "We cannot accept a reranker that blows up latency for long transcripts — p99 needs to be predictable. Cost per user query target is $0.02-$0.05 including retrieval + rerank."

Chunking strategy discussion notes: experimenting with 2–8k token chunk sizes. Favor adaptive chunking by semantic boundaries (paragraph/speaker-change) plus 20% overlap sliding window for edge-context. Considering two index lanes: short-chunk lane for low-latency queries, long-chunk lane (denser embeddings) for high-recall archival searches.

Retrieval architecture: two-stage pipeline planned — ANN vector store (sharded by publication date + topic) -> lightweight lexical filter -> neural reranker (cross-encoder or late-interaction). POC will test both a bi-encoder + cross-encoder reranker and a single-stage (dense-only) reranker to compare latency/cost.

Performance targets for POC: cold index p95 < 300ms (ANN + embed), reranker step p95 < 400ms for sampled subsets, end-to-end median < 250ms for short queries, p99 end-to-end < 700ms. Cost sensitivity: target average cost/query <= $0.03 for typical newsroom query mix.

Reranker tuning notes: plan to fine-tune lightweight cross-encoder on curated QA pairs from newsroom logs (~50k pairs). Evaluate quantized LLM reranker (8-bit) vs distilled transformer reranker to reduce cost. Consider running reranker on Dedicated GPU pool with autoscaling to flatten p99.

Observability & ops asks: token-level cost breakdown, per-query trace linking retrieval->rerank, fallback policies when reranker exceeds latency budget (serve ANN-only results), audit logging for compliance.

References: security deck + initial perf bench links in Drive.
